name: ai-film-studio
description: Pre-production studio for AI-made films in Google Flow / Gemini Omni: story and continuity, cast (human or anthropomorphic animal), storyboard, screenplay with cinematic dialogue, character sheets, and copy-paste prompts for eight formats, in any language Flow speaks.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a rough idea into a shot-ready plan for Google Flow.
interface.longDescription: Pre-production for AI films, start to finish. Give it your storyline and it develops the story and continuity, recommends a format for your platform, casts humans or anthropomorphic animals, storyboards the whole story, writes the screenplay with spoken, cinematic dialogue, builds multi-angle character sheets and location plates, then breaks down each episode into scenes and copy-paste Flow prompts. Music is a choice made once; effects and ambience are never optional. Built for vertical films told episode by episode, and equally at home with Reels, YouTube Shorts, landscape short films, long-form episodes, ads, music videos, trailers, and documentaries. Works in any language Flow speaks: prompts stay English, dialogue is written in the project language so Omni speaks it natively.
defaultPrompt: Start a Malayalam reel movie series about a boy who finds a phone that shows the future.
Storyboard episode 1 of my vertical drama and write the Flow prompts.
I have a vague idea for a 10-minute short film — build the story, characters, and shot list.
